purpose: Second local lesson-delivery set, frozen before its first run. Different project decisions and near-topic negatives from the development set.

lessons.evidence: Customer migrations preserve external_customer_id; we never issue a new one for an existing customer.
lessons.text: Customer migrations preserve each existing external_customer_id instead of issuing a new one.
A thumbnail worker retry keeps the job's original dedupe key after a transient failure.

lessons.evidence: Project pagination uses a stable created_at and id cursor, never an offset.
lessons.text: Project pagination uses a stable created_at and id cursor instead of an offset.

lessons.evidence: Verify webhook signatures against the raw request body, before parsing JSON.
lessons.text: Webhook signature verification uses the raw request body before JSON parsing.
